classification_reasons: All 61 exact 24-hour profiles are unique; no pair of days is identical.
Daily coefficient of variation is 0.428, with component-driven variation documented across all major categories.
Simple chronological baselines are not near-perfect: B1 WAPE 84.8% and peak overlap 33.3%, B2 WAPE 87.9% and peak overlap 29.2%, B3 WAPE 81.4% and peak overlap 34.7%.
Peak observations are explainable by frozen high-power systems and are distributed by block as {'EVENING': 45, 'RETURN_RAMP': 25, 'DAYTIME': 3, 'NIGHT': 1}.

B3.definition: Mean for Monday-00 through Sunday-23 slot, built from August training data only

warnings: No external universal residential-consumption benchmark or invented numeric pass threshold was used.
The gate evaluates 61 synthetic days; results may not generalize beyond the frozen observation window.
PASS means suitable to proceed to forecasting analysis, not proof of real-world accuracy.
